title: T H I C C Weapon case

infobox.effect: Provides 90 inventory slots while only taking up 10

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- Cannot be stored in a backpack.

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The T H I C C Weapon case is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 90 inventory slots in a 6x15 grid and only takes up 10 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
- Weapons (Besides melee)
- Ammunition
- Weapon mods

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text: - 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Choose Your Friends Wisely

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- "T H I C C" is a reference to the word "thicc", which is a meme. The implication is that the case is very large.
- Easter eggs and References : The is modeled after the V700 by Pelican.
